uncited: **Render Light-View Map:** Render the scene from the light's view to generate a world position map.
**Splat Photons:** Use a fragment shader with one thread per pixel of the light-view map.
**Resolve Brick Boundaries:** Because voxels are repeated in adjacent bricks for hardware filtering, direct copying causes thread collisions and bandwidth issues.
*   **Atomic Operations:** Atomic add operations are only available for integer textures in many hardware APIs.
This variant addresses the inconsistency of duplicated voxels at brick boundaries.
It uses six passes (two per axis) to transfer data between neighbors.
First, data is added from the current node to the right (or up/forward) neighbor.
Second, the sum is copied back to the current node.
*   **Time Complexity:** The splatting phase is $O(N)$ where $N$ is the number of pixels in the light-view map.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Depends on the size of the octree and the amount of photon data stored per leaf.
